Why We Don't Furnish

We are often asked why we don't offer "Furnished Packages." The answer is simple: We refuse to overcharge you for uncomfortable furniture.

The Industry Scam

Corporate "Mega-Complexes" charge a premium for furnished units. Let's look at the real cost over a standard 4-year degree.

  • Furnished Premium (Avg): +$150 / mo
  • Lease Term: 48 Months
  • Total Cost to Student: $7,200.00

The Reality: You just paid $7,200 to rent a vinyl couch and a used twin mattress worth maybe $800. And you don't even get to keep it.

The Ironwood Way

We charge you $0 for furniture. You bring your own.

  • IKEA / Thrift Budget: ~$1,500 (One Time)
  • Monthly Rental Fee: $0.00
  • Total Savings: +$5,700.00

The Reality: You save thousands of dollars, you sleep on a new mattress that you chose, and when you graduate, you sell the furniture or take it with you.

The Hygiene Standard

Let's be honest about "Turnover Day." In a furnished complex, the mattress you sleep on has been slept on by 3-5 strangers before you. The couch has absorbed years of spills.

At Stardust Blacksburg, your apartment is a blank slate.

When you move in, the carpets are steam-cleaned, the walls are painted, and the space is empty. The only furniture in the unit is yours. We do not recycle mattresses.
